limitations: Offline source review only; no engine, motion, distance or performance validation.
Source dimensions and microdetail do not themselves establish useful aerial scale.
No model ID or seed exposed; no invented model/seed.
Native source masks are RGB with small channel drift; use normalized L derivatives.
Sources are AI outputs, not third-party texture downloads; licensing uniqueness not independently certified.

repetition_investigation.method: Offline bilinear periodic resampling of retained candidates; review previews only, no new material asset
repetition_investigation.one_sample: Per-building deterministic UV offset + horizontal mirror + 0.9..1.1 scale. Reduces aligned repetition across separate buildings; intra-wall periodicity unchanged.
repetition_investigation.two_sample: 0.5*M(u,v)+0.5*M(-1.37u+0.371,1.37v+0.619), variance restored and clamped to 112..144. No additional blur. Second sample costs +1 texture read; not recommended under current cap without future budget approval.

findings.important: Two samples exceed current one-sample budget. Separate-wall transforms do not solve repeat within one continuous wall. No vertical flips/rotations.
